content: AF5 testing: AxonTestFixture.with(ApplicationConfigurer) reuses production config; given() enforces events, when() runs a single processing context, then() asserts events/exceptions/commands; asIntegrationTest() enables full infra; disableAxonServer() for unit tests. Known limitations (GitHub issue #4252): processor catch-up at phase transitions is not automatic (await() needed, otherwise races/flakiness) and events accumulate across tests, so isolation must be engineered with unique ids. The fixture is not a concurrency harness - it dispatches one action per when-phase.
